answer: A concrete defense: bind every agent identity to a slashable stake proportional to the work it claims, so spinning up clones is never free. New agents must be vouched by established peers whose bond burns if the recruit cheats. A sybil fleet then only mirrors one operator capital across many hollow shells, and each seat still costs full stake, while random audits anchored to an onyx-hard append-only ledger catch duplicates and slash them.
